about: The demo inbox (system/inbox-demo.mjs): invented people and companies, for showing Messages on a computer that is not the person's own. Every name and address here is made up; .example addresses can never be real. 'ago' is counted back from whenever Messages is opened: 45m, 3h, 2d 4h. 'unread' marks a conversation as not yet read; 'files' names attachments (they have no contents).

conversations.name: Ingrid Vasquez-Holm
conversations.subject: Re: Fernlight seed round: next steps

messages.text:
Hi,

Thanks for walking us through the demo on Thursday. The partners liked how fast the agents got from a bug report to a fix.

Could you share the data room, and your retention numbers for the last two cohorts? If those look like what you described, we'd like to move to a term sheet next week.

Best,
Ingrid

Hi Ingrid,

Thank you, that's great to hear. I've added you to the data room; the cohort numbers are on the second tab. Happy to talk through anything that looks odd.

Thanks again

Thanks, the numbers look strong. One question before Thursday: how much of the October growth came from the two design partners, and how much was organic? A rough split is fine.

Ingrid

Hello,

We're all set on our side for the pilot. Our dispatch team would like a kickoff call with you next week, ideally Tuesday or Wednesday morning. Three of us will join.

Also, can your agents work against our staging API rather than production for the first two weeks?

Cheers,
Tobias

Just following up on the times above. Wednesday 10am would suit everyone if that works for you.

Tobias

Hi!

Attached is the invoice for the October sprint: onboarding screens, the new settings page and the icon set. Figma files are in the shared folder.

Lovely working on this one.

Odalys
Thanks Odalys, the icons look fantastic. Paying it today.
Received, thank you! Let me know when you're ready for the marketing site.

Hi,

We're delighted to confirm your talk, "Agents that ship: a year of letting software write software", on the main stage, 2:40pm on day two. It's a 25 minute slot with 5 minutes for questions.

Could you send a short bio and a headshot by Friday?

Warm regards,
Hollis Mbeki-Strand
Programme chair

Hi,

The SAFE for the two angels is ready. I've made the changes we discussed (the pro rata side letter is now separate). You should have a signing link from the e-signature service.

Once both investors sign, I'll circulate the executed copies.

Kind regards,
Delphine
Thanks Delphine, signed just now.

Hey,

One week in with the team plan. Honest feedback: the agents writing the migration was the moment it clicked for everyone. Two asks:

1. Let us pin an agent to a branch so it doesn't wander.
2. A way to see what each agent touched today, in one place.

Happy to jump on a call if useful.

Wren

conversations.name: Marisol Tenwick
conversations.subject: Q3 numbers and the R&D claim

messages.text:
Hi,

Q3 is reconciled. Revenue came in a little ahead of plan; payroll is the only line over. I've started the R&D tax claim: could you send me a list of the experiments you ran this year, a sentence each?

Marisol
Great news, thank you. I'll pull the list together from the repo this week.
Hi! Mateo Lindqvist suggested I reach out. I've spent the last four years on developer tooling at a payments company, mostly build systems and CI.
I saw you're hiring a founding engineer. I'd love to hear more about it, if you're open to a chat this week.
Hi, I lead partnerships at Gridline. A few of our customers have asked whether your agents can open pull requests from our incident timeline. Would you be up for exploring an integration?
Hi Saoirse, yes, that's exactly the kind of thing we want to support. Do you have API docs for the timeline events?
Sending them over now. Free for a call Thursday afternoon?
Congrats on the launch! Watched the video three times. The bit where it fixes its own failing test is wild.
Thanks Mateo! That means a lot coming from you. Coffee soon?
Always. Next week?

Hey, fellow founder here (we're building scheduling for clinics). We're both hiring our first engineers right now. Want to swap notes on what's worked? I have a take-home that candidates actually like.
Ingrid mentioned you're raising. I write small cheques into developer tools and I'd love to hear the story when you have twenty minutes.
Hi Benedikt, thanks for reaching out. Happy to. Does Monday work?
ok the launch video is SO good
who did the music?? my friend wants to know
Saw your story about the new logo. We'd love to show you what we did for two other dev tools companies if you're still looking for a studio.
Thanks! We just finished it with a freelancer, but I'll keep you in mind for the website.
hey! love fernlight. small bug: when an agent renames a file the old tab stays open with the old name
Thank you for telling me! Fixed, it'll be in tomorrow's update.
that was fast 😄
Hi! Following up about the team photos. I have Saturday morning free, the light in your office is great before 10.
Saturday 9am would be perfect. How long should we plan for?
About an hour for four people. I'll bring a backdrop just in case.
